prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio, three women in a single row.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 3 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, with the sweet look of a Japanese idol, soft full cheeks with a gently tapering jaw and a small chin, very large round dark eyes with a wide gaze, softly rounded brows, a small nose and small full lips, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, silver glitter lines across the lids, heavy black liner, very long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, a calm, composed expression, bold vivid tangerine-orange hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer — deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms, wide gold-leaf bands following every deep crease, dense eggshell-white scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's condition: A light dusting of soot sits on her cheek and chin, with a little dirt on her hands and bare feet.

Left woman's restraints: She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, runs in a long loose curve across to the neck ring of the woman beside her in the center.

Left woman's pose: standing full height, facing the camera, close beside the other women, the neck chains hanging in long loose curves between them, her hands relaxed at her sides, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Left woman's footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes.

Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Lighting: the light carving every fold and curve on all 3, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 vertical portrait 8K, taller than it is wide.
